findings.title: Specific waiting period: hernia
findings.explanation_en: The policy requires 24 months for hernia. Covered 14 months with this insurer, 66 months continuously including earlier policies.

explanations.en: The policy requires 24 months for hernia. Covered 14 months with this insurer, 66 months continuously including earlier policies.
explanations.hinglish: Policy me hernia ke liye 24 months tak wait karna hota hai. Is insurer ke saath aapke 14 months hue hain, lekin pehle wali policies ko jod kar lagatar 66 months ka cover ho chuka hai.

findings.fix: Insurer ke Grievance Redressal Officer ko appeal email karo. Attach karo: 1) 2021-03-01 se 2026-09-20 tak ki saari previous policy copies + renewal receipts jisme koi gap na ho, 2) current policy copy (start 2025-07-01), 3) rejection letter. Email me likho: 'Hernia ka 24-month waiting Clause 4.2 ke hisab se first policy se continuous coverage par count karo, 66 months ho chuke hain, portability credit do.' 30 din me reply na aaye to Ombudsman me same set ke saath complaint karo.

fix_localized.hinglish: Insurer ke Grievance Redressal Officer ko appeal email bhejein. Saath me ye documents lagayein: 1) 2021-03-01 se 2026-09-20 tak ki saari purani policy copies + renewal receipts jinme beech me koi gap na ho, 2) current policy copy (start 2025-07-01), 3) rejection letter. Email me likhein: 'Hernia ka 24-month waiting Clause 4.2 ke hisaab se pehli policy se continuous coverage par ginein, 66 months pure ho chuke hain, portability credit dein.' Agar 30 din me jawab na aaye to Ombudsman me isi set ke saath shikayat kar dein.

tool_evidence.tpa_reasoning: Hernia carries 24-month specific waiting under 4.2 from date of inception of first policy. Continuous coverage since 2021-03-01 = 66 months to admission 2026-09-20, so 24 months fully served. Insurer applied only 14 months since current policy start 2025-07-01 and ignored portability credit. Per IN-PORTABILITY waiting served under previous continuous policy must be credited. Evidence pack correctly shows applies_insurer_view true but applies_correctly false.
tool_evidence.advocate_argument: Clause 4.2 khud kehta hai exclusion sirf 'until expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after date of inception of the first policy' tak hai. Admission 2026-09-20 tak 2021-03-01 se 66 months continuous cover hai, jo 24 months se zyada hai. Insurer ne sirf current policy ke 14 months gine aur portability ignore ki. IRDAI Master Circular IN-PORTABILITY kehta hai portability/migration par pehle served waiting period credit karna mandatory hai aur ye policy wording ko override karta hai.
